{{Quote|They are barbarans. No being should have the right to attempt such dishonoring of another.|Porolo Miatamia's aide to Lando Calrissian|<ref name="sotp" />}}
This [[Diamal]]an [[Gender|male]] individual was the '''aide''' of [[Diamal (planet)|Diamal]] [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Porolo Miatamia]]. During the [[Caamas Document Crisis]], Miatamia and his aide were stranded on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Cilpar]] when their [[Starship/Legends|starship]] berth was blockaded by angry protestors. By chance, they found former [[General/Legends|General]] [[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]] near the vicinity and asked him to intercede on the crowd on their behalf, owing his status as a hero of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebellion]]. Calrissian declined their request but offered to transport them back to [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].<ref name="sotp" />
